title: Tunisian Pastry Bites
description: A delicious and flaky pastry filled with a crunchy Tunisian-style filling, perfect for a snack or dessert.
instructions: Roll out pastry sheets and cut into 1-inch squares.
Mix Tunisian Spice Mix, sugar, and water in a small bowl.
Sprinkle crisp rice evenly onto one half of each pastry square.
Dollop a pinch of yeast and salt onto the rice.
Fold the other half of the pastry square over the filling and press edges to seal.
Place the pastry bites on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
